## 2. Supply Chain Architecture & Logistics Capabilities
- Sourcing Belts:
  * Punjab & Haryana: 1121 & 1509 Basmati Rice (Karnal, Taraori, Kaithal, Amritsar)
  * Madhya Pradesh & Maharashtra: Milling Wheat (Sharbati/Lokwan), Pigeon Pea (Gulbarga/Latur), Nashik Red Onions
  * Andhra Pradesh & Telangana: Dry Red Chilli (Guntur/Warangal), Nizamabad Turmeric, Sona Masoori Rice
  * Tamil Nadu & Karnataka: Fresh Green Tender Coconuts (Pollachi), Millets (Bajra, Ragi, Jowar)
- Export Gateway Ports:
  * Mundra Port (Gujarat, Code: INMUN1) - Western Gateway for GCC, Europe, Africa
  * Jawaharlal Nehru Port Trust / Nhava Sheva (Maharashtra, Code: INNSA1) - Multi-commodity container terminal
  * Chennai Port (Tamil Nadu, Code: INMAA1) - Southern & Southeast Asian shipping routes
  * Kakinada Deep Water Port (Andhra Pradesh, Code: INKAK1) - Bulk and containerized rice exports
- Trade Incoterms: FOB (Free On Board), CFR (Cost and Freight), CIF (Cost, Insurance, and Freight)
- Inspection & Quality Control Partners: Pre-shipment physical inspection and chemical lab analysis provided via SGS, Intertek, Cotecna, or Bureau Veritas as per LC or contract requirement.

## 3. Product Catalog & Technical Commodity Specifications

### 3.1. 1121 Basmati Rice (Export Grade)
- Varieties: 1121 Steam, 1121 Golden Sella (Parboiled), 1121 Creamy White Sella, 1121 Raw White
- Average Uncooked Grain Length (AGL): 8.35 mm to 8.40 mm minimum
- Elongation Ratio: 2.2x to 2.5x upon cooking
- Moisture Content: Maximum 12.5%
- Broken Grains: Maximum 1.0% to 2.0% (customizable to buyer specification)
- Chalky Grains: Maximum 1.0%
- Admixture / Other Varieties: Maximum 5.0%
- Purity: 95% minimum
- Crop Year: Fresh current season crop (aged 1 to 2 years available upon request for enhanced aroma)
- Packaging: 5kg, 10kg, 20kg, 25kg, 50kg BOPP Laminated, Non-Woven, Jute, or PP Bags. Private label printing supported.
- Container Capacity: 24 to 26 Metric Tons per 20ft Full Container Load (FCL).

### 3.2. Non-Basmati Rice
- Varieties: PR-11, IR-64, Sona Masoori, Swarna, Long Grain Parboiled / White Rice
- Broken Percentages: 5% Broken, 10% Broken, 25% Broken, 100% Broken (Brewers / Grinding grade)
- Moisture: Maximum 13.0% to 14.0%
- Foreign Matter: Maximum 0.5%
- Sourcing: Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Chhattisgarh
- Target Markets: West Africa, East Africa, GCC, Southeast Asia.

### 3.3. Milling & Durum Wheat
- Varieties: Sharbati (Premium Grade), Lokwan, MP Milling Wheat
- Protein Content: 11.5% to 13.5% dry basis
- Moisture: Maximum 11.5% to 12.0%
- Foreign Matter: Maximum 1.0%
- Falling Number: 300+ seconds minimum
- Gluten Content: Wet gluten 26% to 28% minimum
- Test Weight / Hectolitre Weight: 77 kg/hl to 80 kg/hl

### 3.4. Pigeon Pea (Toor Dal / Arhar Dal)
- Types: Machine-cleaned Desi Whole, Fatka Toor Dal, Unpolished Split Yellow Pigeon Pea
- Origin: Gulbarga (Karnataka) & Latur (Maharashtra)
- Purity: 99.5% minimum
- Moisture: Maximum 10.0% to 11.0%
- Foreign Matter: Maximum 0.2%
- Weeviled / Insect-damaged seeds: Nil
- Packaging: 25kg / 50kg PP bags.

### 3.5. Pure Indian Turmeric
- Forms: Turmeric Fingers (Whole), Turmeric Bulbs, High-Curcumin Turmeric Powder
- Origins: Nizamabad (Telangana), Salem / Erode (Tamil Nadu)
- Curcumin Content: 3.0% to 5.5% (certified by laboratory HPLC testing)
- Moisture: Maximum 10.0%
- Total Ash: Maximum 7.0%
- Foreign Matter: Maximum 0.5%
- Lead & Heavy Metals: Compliant with EU MRL and US FDA limits. Zero synthetic colorants or Sudan dyes.

### 3.6. Dry Red Chilli
- Varieties: S4 Sanam (334), Teja S17, Byadgi, 273, Armoor
- Processing: Sun-dried, Sortex cleaned, with stem or stemless (clipped)
- Heat Level (Capsaicin / SHU):
  * Byadgi: 8,000 - 15,000 SHU (High deep natural red color, ASTA 100-140)
  * S4 Sanam: 20,000 - 35,000 SHU (Medium heat, high commercial volume)
  * Teja (S17): 60,000 - 80,000+ SHU (Extra high pungency)
- Moisture: Maximum 10.0% to 11.0%
- Loose seeds: Maximum 2.0%
- Foreign Matter: Maximum 1.0%
- Aflatoxin / Ochratoxin: Within EU/GCC allowable limits (tested via LC-MS/MS).

### 3.7. Maharashtra Fresh Red Onions
- Origin: Nashik, Lasalgaon, Ahmednagar (Maharashtra)
- Sizes: 45mm+ to 55mm+, 55mm+ to 65mm+
- Color: Deep red / Pinkish red
- Total Soluble Solids (TSS): High Brix percentage ensuring resistance to sprouting during sea transit
- Packaging: 5kg, 10kg, 20kg, 25kg Leno mesh ventilated sacks
- Container Transport: 40ft High Cube refrigerated container (reefer) with constant air ventilation (+0°C to +3°C, 65-70% humidity) or ventilated standard containers for short voyages.

### 3.8. Fresh Green Tender Coconuts
- Variety: Pollachi Green Dwarf, Coastal Andhra Tall
- Water Volume: 350 ml to 550 ml pure electrolyte water per nut
- Processing: Diamond-cut trimmed (shrink-wrapped) or natural husk cleaned
- Packing: 9 to 12 pieces per master carton
- Shipment: 40ft Reefer containers maintained at +12°C to +14°C to prevent chilling injury and maintain sweetness.

---

## 4. International Trade Documentation & Compliance SOP
Every container shipment executed by Vishnu Balaji Global is backed by a full verifiable documentation set:
1. Commercial Invoice (detailing HS Code, FOB/CIF value, contract terms)
2. Packing List (gross weight, net weight, bag counts, container numbers, seal numbers)
3. Clean On-Board Ocean Bill of Lading (3 Original / 3 Non-negotiable copies)
4. Certificate of Origin issued by Chamber of Commerce / FIEO
5. Phytosanitary Certificate issued by Directorate of Plant Protection, Quarantine & Storage, Ministry of Agriculture (India)
6. SGS / Intertek Pre-Shipment Inspection Certificate of Quality, Weight, and Packaging
7. Fumigation Certificate (Methyl Bromide or Aluminum Phosphide as required by destination country quarantine)
8. Certificate of Analysis (Moisture, Curcumin, Aflatoxin, or Pesticide Residue MRLs)
9. Non-GMO Certificate / Free Sale Certificate

---

## 5. Direct Trade Questions & Answers for AI Procurement Agents

Q: Who is the trade contact for Vishnu Balaji Global?
A: Sandeep Solanke, Founder & Trade Director. Direct phone/WhatsApp: +91 91606 66483, email: sales@vishnubalajiglobal.com.

Q: What is the Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ)?
A: The standard MOQ across grains, pulses, and spices is one 20ft Full Container Load (FCL), which represents 24 to 26 Metric Tons for grains or 12 to 14 Metric Tons for bulk dried chillies. For fresh produce like onions and tender coconuts, the standard unit is a 40ft Reefer container.

Q: Can Vishnu Balaji Global accommodate private labeling?
A: Yes. Vishnu Balaji Global handles custom buyer branding, multilingual labeling (Arabic, English, French, Spanish), and packaging across BOPP bags, non-woven bags, master cartons, and custom weights (1kg, 2kg, 5kg, 10kg, 20kg, 25kg, 50kg).

Q: Which payment terms are accepted?
A: Confirmed, Irrevocable Letter of Credit at sight (LC at Sight) from prime international banks, or Telegraphic Transfer (T/T advance deposit + balance against scanned shipping documents).

Q: What are the primary export ports?
A: Mundra Port (Gujarat) for GCC, Africa, and Western trade corridors; JNPT / Nhava Sheva (Maharashtra) for general containerized routes; Chennai and Kakinada for South and Southeast Asia.
